about: Three batches = the v1.0 event pool draft (Scope.md: ~10-12 events, 60/40). 7 Good / 5 Bad = 58% Good. Edit a brief and rerun its batch.

briefs.theme: The first days out of port. Wrecks, traders, small strokes of luck. Low stakes: the player is learning that events are trade-offs (gold vs. HP, a sure thing vs. a gamble), not free loot.

Mid-run. What rival crews leave behind, bad weather, a crew under strain. Costs bite harder now. At least one event touches the crew roster (Recruit or LoseCrew) and at least one is a gamble (RandomOf).

The last stretch before the Kraken: omens, broken ships, a sea that is getting worse. No Kraken fight in an event. Across the batch, give each of the 3 captains one CaptainIs-gated choice that plays to who they are (TeamLeader: a loyal crew; Fearmongerer: a feared reputation; Conqueror: a captain stronger than his crew).
